answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Reaching the haven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. A shale of per-task receipts records who did what, and the marble of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
